unsupported_rows: Identity under both solvers; original full-bank FFN output and raw skip preserved. No unsupported row becomes a graph node.
forest: True point support recursively through original ids0/ids1/ids2; edges original membership only, independent coarse-root components.
mean: S alone preserves constants and unweighted node sums in exact real arithmetic; entire nonlinear composition need not preserve original feature mean. Not a numerical native gate.
no_new_parameters_or_rng: Original CTF constructor byte/AST unchanged; helper contains functions only. Actual initialization pairing is still NOT_RUN.
no_edges_control: Mathematical S=I control on included rows yields original M95; no extra native arm was executed.
dtype: No production dtype override or tolerance. Float metadata and native tensor operations need future real FP32 checking.
